environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on AWS EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to the instance on port 3000. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No authentication layer in front of the application. The ALB target group health check hits /health. CloudWatch basic monitoring enabled. The application runs as a single process via pm2 with default timeout settings (no request timeout configured).

config.timeout: ALB idle timeout 60s, no application-level request timeout
